feeds.title: Homeschooling with Dyslexia Blog
feeds.description: Homeschooling with Dyslexia Blog is a valuable resource for parents who have chosen to homeschool their children with dyslexia. The blog offers practical tips, curriculum recommendations, and insights into creating a supportive learning environment for dyslexic students at home. It aims to empower parents with the knowledge and tools they need to effectively educate and support their dyslexic children.

feeds.title: Triad Moms on Main » Education for Special Needs
feeds.description: Triad Moms on Main is an online parenting resource for the Triad, NC area. Our website launched in October of 2010. We are an all-inclusive resource for parents that features daily blogs, directories, a detailed local events calendar, contests and giveaways.

feeds.title: HomeSchool Resources and TidBits
feeds.description: Welcome to my Blog about special needs resources and the ins and outs of what it is like to raise a special needs child.

feeds.title: Learn Differently Blog
feeds.description: At LearnDifferently.com, Kathy Kuhl coaches parents teaching children with learning challenges including dyslexia, attention deficit disorder, autism, giftedness, and other issues. She provides resources, encouragement, and practical tips. She speaks, writes, and gives private consultations.

feeds.title: This Reading Mama Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Becky, I am currently a homeschooling mama to four kiddos and the creator of This Reading Mama. I started blogging as a way to share ideas with other parents, teachers, and tutors. It also deepened my passion for helping struggling learners in any way that I could in my little corner of the internet.

feeds.title: Different By Design Learning
feeds.description: In this blog, Shawna writes about special needs, homeschooling and the messiness of motherhood. Different By Design Learning helps you feel a little lighter, more encouraged, and determined to live with hope.

feeds.title: Look! We're Learning Blog
feeds.description: We're committed to making learning fun for kids! Follow us to get kid-approved teaching ideas and activities that are hands-on, cool, and just plain fun!

feeds.title: Raising Lifelong Learners Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Colleen, gifted specialist, educational consultant, author, speaker, and homeschool mom of four gifted/twice-exceptional kids. I help families like yours trust themselves to embrace the adventure of a delight-directed approach to education with lessons, challenges, tips, classes, and a community of like-minded kids and their parents.

feeds.title: Raising the Extraordinary
feeds.description: For parents of children with special needs to know they aren't alone to hear and share stories among fellow parents of these extraordinary children. Our passion is raising awareness of special needs families and helping parents of children with special needs on their journey. From one mom, dad, & family in the trenches to another.

feeds.title: iHomeschool Network » Special Needs
feeds.description: Find ways and ideas to homeschool children with special needs along with tips for curriculum. iHomeschool Network connects homeschoolers through social media and we help companies reach the homeschool market.

feeds.title: Learn Differently Blog
feeds.description: At LearnDifferently.com, Kathy Kuhl coaches parents teaching children with learning challenges including dyslexia, attention deficit disorder, autism, giftedness, and other issues. She provides resources, encouragement, and practical tips. She speaks, writes, and gives private consultations.

feeds.title: Home Schooling The Special Needs Child Blog
feeds.description: Susan Blackwell has decades of experience homeschooling her own children as well as being a Special Needs Counselor for all three of the legal home schooling options in South Carolina. She is observant, insightful, and extremely knowledgeable regarding special needs diagnoses as well as the curricula that accommodate or address those issues and the testing needed.

feeds.title: Every Star Is Different
feeds.description: We are dedicated to helping families with children who have emotional, developmental, and trauma based challenges become happy and healthy through the implementation of Montessori and minimalism principles in the home. Explore our articles on how we are homeschooling our specially abled children, tips to homeschool them and more!

feeds.title: Cedars Story
feeds.description: Cedar has Down Syndrome and for all my education and background I knew very, very little about Down Syndrome.Immediately a passion was born to help spread information, awareness, and help to others who, like me, are gifted a child with Down Syndrome. Our goal is to encourage, educate, and bring hope to those whose lives are touched by Down Syndrome.

feeds.title: SPED Homeschool
feeds.description: We at SPED Homeschool believe every child can succeed when provided individualized instruction and that homeschooling is one of the best options a family has for providing this type of education for a unique learner. Find how-to instructional articles, encouragement, tips and advice for special education homeschooling families.
